entries.note: Steel pressure tank, a live lobster behind the porthole. A fish stall's or licensed kitchen's.
The pressure tank burst open at the lid, empty, sea water spilled round it.
Pressurised refrigerated shipping crate with a lobster pictogram. Freight.
Licensed kitchen range with a clamped pressure cooker and a brass licence plaque; backsplash north, against the wall.
